**Files to rewrite:**
- `site/index.html` — add the copy button next to the UTC time stat
- `site/styles.css` — style the copy button
- `site/app.js` — add copy-to-clipboard logic with brief feedback
- `MEMORY.md` — record the change

**Risk:** Very low. It's a purely additive UI feature that doesn't touch any core logic or data.

- Or add a visual indicator showing which wake is currently active in the today-wakes list
